message: That's a great idea.  I wish someone had tried that with my college English classes.  I was unfamiliar with the concept of plagiarism before attending university (just by virtue of going to school in Pakistan where we're encouraged to produce work by copying it from places), and something like this would have been incredibly useful.  You're particularly right about how students tend to plagiarise not because they're incapable of doing the work, but because they're stressed out and want to produce everything on time, as well as they possibly can, even if that means appropriating what has been done by other people.  Personally, I blame the focus on grades and achievement over actual learning (wasn't that nice and overly simplistic?).
